test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Checks
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow properly enforces required document checks and governance approvals before site activation.
prerequisites: Test environment with configured CTMS
Test user accounts with appropriate roles
Sample site documentation files

test_steps.action: Log in as a clinical operations user and initiate a new site activation request
test_steps.expected_result: System presents the site activation workflow with required document upload fields

test_steps.action: Upload incomplete documentation set and attempt to submit for approval
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents submission and displays validation errors for missing documents

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents and submit for governance approval
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts submission and routes to appropriate approvers with audit trail entry

test_steps.action: Log in as approver and review documents, then approve activation
test_steps.expected_result: System records e-signature and updates site status to activated with complete audit trail

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all document requirements
Approval process follows configured governance checkpoints
Complete audit trail maintained for all actions
E-signatures comply with 21 CFR Part 11
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail captures all document uploads and status changes
E-signatures are securely linked to approver identity and timestamp
Document version control maintained throughout workflow

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control for CRO and Sponsor Users

test_steps.expected_result: System denies access to financial reports and displays appropriate access denied message

test_steps.action: Log in as sponsor clinical lead and verify access to study oversight functions
test_steps.expected_result: System grants appropriate access to study management functions per role configuration

test_steps.action: Attempt to access the system via SSO with invalid credentials
test_steps.expected_result: System rejects authentication and prevents access to any system functions

test_steps.action: Verify user provisioning via SCIM interface by creating a new test user
test_steps.expected_result: System properly provisions new user with correct role assignments and organizational affiliation

acceptance_criteria: Users can only access functions permitted by their assigned roles
CRO and sponsor users have appropriate segregation of duties

SCIM provisioning correctly assigns user attributes
data_integrity_requirements: User access rights are properly enforced and cannot be bypassed

User provisioning changes are tracked and verifiable

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Checks
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces required document checks and transitions through governance states as defined in the vendor configuration.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is installed and accessible
Test study and site records created
Test user accounts with appropriate roles (e.g., Site Manager, CRA)

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS as a user with Site Manager role and initiate site activation for a test site.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the site activation workflow with required document checklist.

test_steps.expected_result: System prevents workflow advancement and displays error message indicating missing required documents.

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents (e.g., FDA 1572, CVs, lab certifications) and submit for approval.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts all documents and transitions workflow to approval pending state.

test_steps.expected_result: System transitions site to active status and records approval in audit trail.

regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records and signatures
ICH E6 R2 for trial management and documentation requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all document uploads and state changes
System must maintain document version control and integrity
urs_requirements: URS-027-002: Implement site activation workflow with required document checks
